details: Approved concept #12 dark chef-signature UI. Old Ruby White mobile CSS and helper are replaced, not overlaid: one chef-signature.css and one chef-signature-ui.js with the three stable navigation/update/cloud scripts. Photos use existing optimized black-background sushi/chef/ingredient assets. Workspace replaces ruby-workspace.css with one dark signature theme while keeping base editor/A4 control sheets. Five tabs, live status, TTK/PDF/projects/auth/routes unchanged. No signed APK was built. Phone pixel-exact match and authenticated editor workflows still require on-device testing.
